subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Shared: answers higher-order questions ('What would have happened if...?'); gives an opinion on what was read

show.line: Good readers think ahead. If the rain stops, what happens to the puddle? It dries up! Let's think about stories.

rounds.story: Lesedi leaves her ice lolly in the sun. She goes to play. What will happen to the ice lolly?
Tau forgets to water his plant for a week. What would happen to the plant?
rounds.praise: Yes! Without water the plant droops.

rounds.story: The baby cries. Mama gives her milk. The baby stops crying. Why did the baby cry?
rounds.praise: Yes! She was hungry, so milk helped.

rounds.prompt: Ben drops a glass on the floor. What would happen to the glass? Say it.

rounds.story: Kgosi has no umbrella. Dark clouds come. He runs home fast. What would happen if he walked slowly?
rounds.praise: Yes! The rain would catch him.

rounds.prompt: Was it a good idea for Kgosi to run home? Tap what you think.
rounds.praise: Thank you for sharing what you think!

hints: Think about what usually happens. Ice in the sun melts.
Ask yourself, why did that happen?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Lesedi leaves her ice lolly in the sun.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The ice lolly will get colder!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The sun is hot. The lolly melts.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's think together. Hot sun, cold lolly. It melts!

parent_line: Can say what would happen next in a story and why something happened.
